CL_ACOPF2017_2022.to: AP, RSE, RGE, RI, RGBC, RSC, RMWC
CL_ACOPF2017_2022.status_note: Incorporated into the Foundations Code 2024 Edition 已納入地基守則 2024 年版
points: Foundations Code amendments (Jul 2022): (a) **cl 4.2.2(2)(a)** – **Category 3** intermediate soil excluded from the plate load test trigger; (b) **cl 5.3.3(1)** – tension proof test not needed if tension capacity < half the shaft compressive capacity and the piles are in the compression proof test pool; check the **soil column and rock or soil cone**; (c) **cl 5.3.3(2)(b), Fig. 5.1** – overlapping **rock cone** checks for socketed piles; (d) **cl 5.3.3(3)(c), Fig. 5.2** – overlapping **soil cone** checks for piles in granular soil; (e) figure titles.

CL_QSQAPCCMICHSPTG2022.status_note: Temporary arrangements during cross-boundary control; standing rules in APP-37, APP-143, ADV-36, PNRC 63 疫情期間臨時安排；長期規定見 APP-37、APP-143、ADV-36、PNRC 63
points: Supervision and audit of **precast concrete**, **MiC** and **heat soak of tempered glass** in Mainland factories rationalised in **APP-37, APP-143, ADV-36 and PNRC 63** (Apr 2022). During cross-boundary control: first-batch inspections by RSE/AP/AS and QS/audit by AS and **TCP T3** may be by **videotelephony**.
**預製混凝土**、**組裝合成建築**及**鋼化玻璃熱浸**的監督已於 2022 年 4 月修訂的 APP-37、APP-143、ADV-36、PNRC 63 中理順；跨境管制期間，首批產品檢查及 T3 監督可用**視像**進行。

Then on-site audit sampling rises to **≥ 2 %, min. one per 10 batches** (precast) and **≥ 2 % of each MiC module type**. If TCP T1 full-time factory supervision is disrupted by lockdowns, video supervision may be approved case by case with AS audits **biweekly** and **≥ 50 %** of tempered glass panes supervised by TCP T3 by video; assistants must not be RC supervisory staff; log books and DVDs kept.
工地抽查提高至**≥ 2%（每 10 批最少 1 件）**及**每類組件 ≥ 2%**；如封城影響 T1 全時間監督，可個別批准視像監督，獲授權簽署人**每兩星期**抽查，**≥ 50%** 鋼化玻璃由 T3 以視像監督。

CL_ACOPSUS2013_2022.to: AP, RSE, RGE, RI, RGBC, RSC, RMWC
CL_ACOPSUS2013_2022.status_note: Part of the Concrete Code 2013 (2020 Ed.) as the Feb 2022 amendment 已成為混凝土守則 2022 年 2 月修訂
points: Concrete Code amendments (Feb 2022): (a) **cl 6.2.3, Fig. 6.18b** – design of **plain concrete linings** for tunnels and caverns (always in compression, good rock; nLT ≤ **0.32 h fcu** for e ≤ 0.1h; ≤ 0.4(h − 2e) fcu for 0.1h–0.3h; max eccentricity **0.3h**); (b) **cl 10.3.4.2, Table 10.2** – use of **100 mm and 150 mm cubes**; (c) **cl 11.7.5.4, Table 11.2** – early strength by the **maturity method**; (d) Annex A adds **ASTM C1074-19ε1**.
混凝土守則修訂（2022 年 2 月）：(a) 隧道及洞穴**素混凝土襯砌**設計；(b) **100 及 150 毫米立方體**使用；(c) 以**成熟度法**監察早期強度；(d) 附錄加入 ASTM C1074。

After a **fatal accident with a large electric gate (15 Aug 2022)**: inspect all large electric gates at once, especially **manual mode**, and advise owners to arrange **regular inspection and maintenance** of large metal gates. See LD Safety Guide on Gate Work, EMSD CoP and guide on electric sliding gates, **APP-146**.
